result:
The decisive mistake was the Orchestrator's instruction at step 6. The step 4 search results were generic New York City directory listings (dojos.info, Yelp) rather than anything close to the NYSE. Instead of redirecting to a map-based search for schools near 11 Wall St, the Orchestrator told WebSurfer to open those listings and verify them. That led WebSurfer into dojos.info, a citywide list sorted by distance from an unrelated point, and into ad pages.

The team never examined Wall Street-area schools such as Renzo Gracie Jiu-Jitsu Wall Street. It ended with the wrong answer, "Alliance Jiu Jitsu, NY Jidokwan Taekwondo". Both are at least 1.5 miles away, well beyond a five-minute walk.

AGENT: Orchestrator (-> WebSurfer)
STEP: 6
